name: CloudFactory
work: Managed-team AI data work, such as labelling medical X-rays, spotting roof damage for insurers and measuring forest cover, plus data annotation roles.

source.title: AFP via Citizen Digital: Can Kenya attract the outsourcing jobs of the AI future? (July 2025)

availability.note: CloudFactory has operated in Kenya since 2014, with about 130 staff and 3,000 freelancers reported in 2025. It also held a virtual recruitment open day for Uganda. Other African countries are unclear.

items.text: CloudFactory recruits, hires, trains and oversees workers in teams, rather than running an open sign-up crowd.
It posts full-time roles in Kenya, including General Data Annotation Specialist.
Applications go through the CloudFactory careers portal on Workable.
Its Nairobi recruitment open days required registration, and only confirmed attendees received the venue details.
Real CloudFactory open days only share the venue with confirmed attendees. Be wary of anyone charging a fee to attend or to secure a place.
